title: General Yang

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Commandant. 5 v e

Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 26
Date. 26th January 1916

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang has sent a telegram
to Peking reporting that several persons are famine striken
in Pootung and requesting that the sufferers be exempt
from tax for one year. The General has also recommended
that he be authorised to contribute from the public
funds towards the relief of the sufferers.
A gun boat which is conveying 2,000 rifles from
Kiangnan Arsenal to Peking left here yesterday forenoon.
It is reported that Minister Liu has suggested to
Admiral Li to dismiss several naval officers who are
suspected of disloyalty. The latter has declined to
act on the suggestion. The relations of the Minister
and the Admiral are now strained.
It is reported that considerable friction exists
between Military Governor Yang and his deputy General Lu.
It is reported that the Shanghai Taoyin entertained
the editors of the local Chinese newspapers to dinner in
his yamen on the 25th inst, when he explained to them
the awkward position that he had been placed in by their
refusal to change the calendar. It is said that, as
a result of what took place, all the editors, including
those of the Shen Pao and Sin Wan Pao, will date their
papers according to the monarchical calendar.

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

警务处，
（侦探科）

总监。5 v e

上海工部局。
刑事侦缉处。
I. O. REG
编号 26
日期：1916年1月26日

先生：
据报，杨将军已向北京发送电报，称浦东有数人遭受饥荒，并请求免除灾民一年赋税。该将军还建议授权其从公款中拨款救济灾民。
一艘运送2,000支步枪从江南兵工厂前往北京的炮舰于昨天上午离开此地。
据报，刘总长已向李海军上将建议撤换几名被怀疑不忠的海军军官。后者拒绝采纳该建议。目前，刘总长与李海军上将之间的关系趋于紧张。
据报，军事长官杨将军与其副手卢将军之间存在严重摩擦。
据报，上海道台于本月25日在其衙门宴请当地中文报纸编辑，并向他们解释，由于他们拒绝更改历法，使其陷入尴尬境地。据悉，作为此次事件的结果，包括《申报》和《新闻报》在内的所有编辑都将按照君主制历法（即旧历/阴历）标注报纸日期。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
首席侦探督察。

警察巡官队长
